title: Normalized monoidal section equivalence with actual derived counit
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme, with internal modules and the exact section-action equivalence $E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the native uncompleted derived tensor and internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. There exist a normalized ringed-site duality model $S$ [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], a K-flat-normalized tensor comparison $t$ [def-sfb-internal-section-derived-tensor-comparison], a strong monoidal core $m$ on $D(E)$, and a natural derived Hom isomorphism $\theta$. The inverse tensorator of $m$ equals $t$; $m$ carries the actual native Koszul braiding to the symmetry of $S$; and $D(E)$ carries the actual Hom-first evaluation to the composite of $t$, $\theta\otimes 1$, and the counit of $S$. These assertions hold on arbitrary unbounded derived inputs.

proof.text: Descend these coherent comparisons along flat-term K-flat localization. Their inverse tensor maps define a strong monoidal core for the derived section functor; its associativity, unitality and symmetry are the equations on K-flat representatives. Normalize the ringed closed model with these constraints, obtaining the RingedSiteDualityModel and its TensorComparison.

proof.text: The evaluation-normalized Hom isomorphism identifies the counits. On the K-flat representatives its tensor factor is exactly the comparison descended in the preceding step, by its normalization square. Uniqueness of parametrized right adjoints identifies its Hom map with θ, giving the displayed evaluation identity.

lean.statement:
theorem internal_section_monoidal_normalization
    (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ (S : RingedSiteDualityModel.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ.X X))
      (t : TensorComparison Λ.X X S.closed S.models)
      (m : @Functor.CoreMonoidal _ _ _ _ _ S.closed.monoidal (forward Λ.X X))
      (θ : Functor.uncurry.obj (CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ.X X) ⋙ forward Λ.X X ≅
        ((forward Λ.X X).op.prod (forward Λ.X X)) ⋙ hom Λ.X X),
      (∀ K N, (@Functor.CoreMonoidal.μIso _ _ _ _ _ S.closed.monoidal
        (forward Λ.X X) m K N).inv = t.iso.hom.app (K, N)) ∧
      (∀ K N, (@Functor.CoreMonoidal.μIso _ _ _ _ _ S.closed.monoidal
          (forward Λ.X X) m K N).hom ≫
          (forward Λ.X X).map (β_ K N).hom =
        (S.symmetric.braiding _ _).hom ≫
          (@Functor.CoreMonoidal.μIso _ _ _ _ _ S.closed.monoidal
            (forward Λ.X X) m N K).hom) ∧
      (∀ K N, (forward Λ.X X).map
          ((β_ ((ihom K).obj N) K).hom ≫ (ihom.ev K).app N) =
        t.iso.hom.app ((ihom K).obj N, K) ≫
          S.closed.tensor.map
            (X := ((forward Λ.X X).obj ((ihom K).obj N), (forward Λ.X X).obj K))
            (Y := ((hom Λ.X X).obj (op ((forward Λ.X X).obj K),
              (forward Λ.X X).obj N), (forward Λ.X X).obj K))
            (θ.hom.app (op K, N), 𝟙 _) ≫
          S.closed.evaluation ((forward Λ.X X).obj K) ((forward Λ.X X).obj N))
